name: Magicheskoe Rabstvo
source:
In the game you will play as two girls: Gabriella Rancher and Suzie Carries, both are students of the magical University. 

The main antagonist is called Throdd Loddy, he is blond and skinny and he literally hates Gabriella and Suzie. With the power of some unknown magical artefact, he dominates the girls and uses them according to his own dirty purposes.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
游戏中，你将扮演两名女孩：加布里埃拉·兰彻与苏茜·卡里斯，她们都是魔法大学的学生。

主要反派名叫索德·洛迪。他金发瘦削，憎恨加布里埃拉与苏茜。借助某件未知魔法神器的力量，他支配女孩们，按自己的肮脏目的利用她们。

[来源：itch.io]
